shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on an upright slab with rounded top
human or humanoid figures with arms extended
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
row of repeated rounded/loaf-like forms along the upper edge
justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs with rounded tops organised into stacked horizontal registers, with profile animals/birds and figures with outstretched arms, and both have a row of repeated rounded elements across the top zone. But the content differs fundamentally: A shows isolated schematic zoomorphs (crouching quadrupeds, a big-billed bird, an abstract animal head) with no interaction, while B shows a narrative human scene of clothed figures in profile with a hairstyle convention, gesturing toward an offering table with vessels and plants under a canopy-like element, plus small sign-like marks; the modelling conventions (blocky, near-sculptural in A versus flat, fine-lined, proportioned human bodies in B) are also unlike.
